episode_summary: In this episode, Bill Melnick shares his journey from a corporate career at Ralph Lauren to becoming a top luxury real estate agent. He discusses the importance of lifestyle marketing, understanding market nuances, and leveraging personal networks to succeed in high-value property sales. The episode also explores the role of AI in real estate and effective use of social media for building a personal brand.
